languages.title: Investment Banking - Analyst Intern - Business and Tech-Enabled Services
languages.shortDescription: Duties & Responsibilities: deal execution, client presentations and financial analysis.
languages.shortDescriptionHtml: Duties & Responsibilities: deal execution, client presentations and financial analysis.
languages.description:
Position: Investment Banking Analyst Intern (Business and Tech-Enabled Services), Paris, six months from March 2027.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Work on mandates across a broad range of deal types
  • Draft client presentations and information memoranda
  • Carry out financial analysis, modelling and valuation
  • Help the deal team execute transactions from start to signing

Requirements

  • Final-year student at a business or engineering school, or a university finance programme
  • A first internship in M&A, transaction services or private equity
  • Fluent French and English; strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
